title: Change Administration Fee Schedule Notes, Workplace Cafe Management Program
content:
The repeat change administration fee is 2450.00 USD and the settled change administration fee is 1180.00 USD. Both figures stand against a Workplace Cafe Management Program contract whatever service model the cafe is running under, and both are read on the day the client confirms an approved change of service model.

Which of the two the contract carries, or whether neither is reached, is read from what the contract's own record shows about an earlier change of service model.

| What the contract's record shows | The change administration fee the contract carries |
| --- | --- |
| A change of service model that took effect less than twelve months before the day the client confirms | The repeat change administration fee, 2450.00 USD |
| A change of service model that took effect twelve months or more before the day the client confirms | The settled change administration fee, 1180.00 USD |
| No earlier change of service model | The change administration fee printed against the service model the contract is moving from |

**The footnote as written.** A contract whose record already shows a change of service model that took effect less than twelve months before the day the client confirms carries the repeat change administration fee in place of the printed change administration fee; a contract whose record shows a change of service model that took effect twelve months or more before that day carries the settled change administration fee in place of it; and a contract whose record shows no earlier change of service model carries the printed change administration fee.

**Counting the twelve months.** The span runs from the day the earlier change of service model took effect, as the contract's record shows that day, to the day the client confirms the change now in hand. A span short of 12 months is a recent change and carries 2450.00 USD; a span of 12 months or longer carries 1180.00 USD. The twelve month day itself belongs to the longer side.

**Readings on hypothetical dates.** On a hypothetical contract whose record shows a change of service model that took effect on 2025-04-10, with the client confirming on 2026-02-18, the span is short of twelve months and the fee carried is the repeat change administration fee of 2450.00 USD. On a hypothetical contract whose record shows a change of service model that took effect on 2024-11-30, with the client confirming on 2026-02-18, the span is twelve months or more and the fee carried is the settled change administration fee of 1180.00 USD. Where the record shows no earlier change of service model, neither of those two figures is reached and the fee carried is the change administration fee printed against the service model the contract is moving from.
